promise: June 19, 2013: if the labor market improved as forecast, the Fed would 'moderate the monthly pace of purchases later this year' and 'likely conclude purchases around the middle of 2014' (QE3 taper guidance)
description: Bernanke described a conditional path for tapering later in 2013 and ending purchases around mid-2014 if the economy evolved as projected. Asset purchases continued through October 2014.
evidence: The June 2013 transcript emphasizes that the timetable depended on incoming economic data.

review.note: Announcement is June 19, 2013, not 2020. Bernanke explicitly made the path conditional on economic data and referred to mid-2014, not a December deadline. Purchases continued until October 2014. Kept is not supported against an unconditional midyear promise because no such promise was made.
